notes.title: Demo is released!
notes.notes: [p]Today’s the day! The long wait is over. We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]Medieval Darkness Demo[/b] is officially available![/p][p]The demo features four of the five playable classes, multiple quests, and one mission area packed with danger and choice. Whether you battle through questlines or hold out against the final boss on Day 5, the path is yours to carve.[/p][p]You can grab the demo right now from our demo link on our steam page. Play as much as you want, experiment with different strategies, and tell us what you think.  Your feedback will help shape the journey ahead.[/p][p]This is just the beginning. We’ll be moving toward Early Access after Next Fest(next month), and today’s release is a huge milestone on that road.[/p][p]Thanks to everyone who playtested and supported us, you rock dudes (and dudettes).[/p][p][b]Play the demo. Fight the darkness. Rock on.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo coming out 9-17-25!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Update: Demo Release Coming Soon![/b][/p][p]Hello everyone,
It has been a while since we last posted here on the main store page. Most of our recent updates have been focused on the Playtest, and now we finally have some big news to share.[/p][p]First, a huge [b]thank you[/b] to all of our Playtesters. Your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions have been incredibly valuable in shaping the game. We couldn’t have gotten the demo to where it is today without your time and support.[/p][p]We are excited to announce that the [b]Demo for Medieval Darkness[/b] is finished and will be released on [b]September 17, 2025[/b]![/p][p]The demo will feature:[/p][list][*][p]Four of the five playable classes[/p][/*][*][p]A wide variety of quests[/p][/*][*][p]A full mission area with [b]multiple ways to win[/b] (either by completing a quest line or by surviving the final boss battle at the end of the fifth day/night cycle, beware the final boss is no joke dudes!)[/p][/*][*][p]No time limits...you can play the mission over and over to collect more gear.[/p][/*][/list][p]Looking ahead, our roadmap includes releasing the game into Early Access sometime after Steam Next Fest. We’ll share more details as development continues, but for now our focus is on polishing the demo and gathering your feedback.[/p][p]Stay tuned, and thank you again for being part of this journey. We’re excited to finally bring Medieval Darkness to a wider audience, and we can’t wait to hear what you think.[/p][p]—Mech Monkey Studios[/p]

notes.title: Playtest open to a select few!
notes.notes:
If you received an email awhile back, then the playtest should now be live and in your steam library. If you haven't yet been accepted, don't lose hope! Players will be accepted in a random fashion throughout this coming week.  This first playtest ends Sunday May 12th. So be sure to check it out as soon as you can! Also join us on discord, your feedback is crucial at this time. 
[url=https://discord.com/invite/KkEdbQkwQU]Discord link[/url]

notes.title: Upcoming Playtest
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Chosen ones![/h1]

The time for our first ever playtest is quickly approaching. It has a been a long road for our two man dev team. But we are almost ready to have a limited number of outside alpha tester to check out our game. We hope to have a weekend playtest very soon!

If you have already clicked the request access button on our store page and received an email saying it you can install the playtest please disregard. The playtest isn't available yet. We will make an announcement here before the playtest, but please [url=https://discord.com/invite/KkEdbQkwQU]join our discord[/url] for the latest info.
